target: Amenaza superior natural de la Sierra de Hoshai; depredador mayor de montaña.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA — CREATURE MUST BE THE PRIMARY FOCAL SUBJECT. Gran cuadrúpedo depredador de montaña, pelaje grueso y patas delanteras extraordinariamente fuertes. Mostrar cuerpo completo y una silueta original, pesada al frente y adaptada a cornisas; no convertirlo en oso, felino o lobo.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA. The Rasgacumbres is the unmistakable primary focal subject and occupies roughly 45–60% of the frame. Show one complete adult in low three-quarter side view on a steep broken Hoshai terrace. Exactly four limbs. Original mountain-predator anatomy: deep compact ribcage; short powerful neck; broad low head with forward-focused predatory attention but no exaggerated fangs; exceptionally massive shoulders and long muscular forelegs with broad gripping paws; hindquarters leaner and springy for climbing; thick weatherproof coat broken into shorter fur on the lower legs; long enough tail to balance on steep terrain without becoming feline. Pose it braced across uneven stone, looking downslope rather than roaring. A difficult cornice and displaced stones communicate scale and hauling strength. Cool gray rock, cold wind, sparse alpine scrub, neutral daylight. Environment remains subordinate to the animal.
negative_constraints: No wings, horns, armor, spikes or magical traits
Do not depict a literal bear, big cat, wolf or hyena; keep an original quadruped silhouette
Forequarters must be visibly stronger than hindquarters
No attack toward camera, gore or prey carcass as focal subject
CATEGORY LOCK: creature only; the environment must remain secondary.
